heading: Insurance & Schemes
intro: To ensure patients receive the best treatment without financial burden, IRCS Cancer Hospital supports several government and corporate health schemes.

schemes.name: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva (Aarogyasri)
schemes.description: A flagship health scheme by the Government of Andhra Pradesh providing financial assistance for specialised medical treatments.

schemes.name: Aarogya Raksha
schemes.description: A comprehensive health scheme for families not covered under Aarogyasri.

schemes.name: Aarogya Bhadratha
schemes.description: A dedicated health scheme for Andhra Pradesh Police personnel and their families.

schemes.name: Employee Health Scheme (EHS)
schemes.description: Healthcare cover for state government employees and pensioners.

schemes.name: AP GENCO Health Scheme
schemes.description: Medical reimbursement for employees of AP GENCO and their dependents.

highlights: Cashless treatment available under eligible schemes
Advanced cancer care with state-of-the-art facilities
Experienced oncologists and specialised medical teams
